key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:0166
name: compute_scaled_object_position
description: Computes a scaled position value for an object from its fields using a fixed-point multiply helper and a divide. It subtracts whole-unit steps while the value exceeds a limit, walking a list of segments as it goes, and calls a helper when the value passes a second limit.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:0208
name: store_helper_when_range_exceeded
description: When the difference between the input and a stored value exceeds the fixed limit of 457020, calls a helper and stores its result in a field of the structure.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:0228
name: call_helper_when_nonzero
description: Calls a helper routine when the 16-bit value in the D1 register is nonzero, then returns.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:0258
name: stub_return_immediately
description: Contains no operations and returns at once.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:025C
name: advance_phase_state_machine
description: Advances a stored phase accumulator by an input value and steps a small state machine through its phases. It loads segment start and end values from a source record and recalculates a helper value at each change, returning early when the record pointer is empty or the phase is terminal.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:0288
name: step_phase_state_machine
description: Steps the same phase state machine without first advancing its accumulator. It loads segment values from a source record on each phase change and recalculates a helper value, returning early in the terminal phase.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:029A
name: step_phase_state_machine
description: Steps the same phase state machine from its entry point, loading segment values from a source record on each phase change and recalculating a helper value, and returns when the terminal phase is reached.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:02DC
name: start_phase_and_configure_channel
description: Puts the phase record into its fourth state with a copied value and calls a helper. It then updates an accumulator when a flag bit is set, configures the global channel record with a mask from one field and a default duration of 1000 when that field is zero, and calls a routine from a table.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:02F0
name: step_phase_segment_values
description: Advances a phase record through its segment values. From the third state it loads the next segment and subtracts a count from the accumulator, reloading segment data from a source table when the count reaches zero or moving to the terminal state when the segment ends.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:030E
name: load_phase_segment_from_pointer
description: Loads a phase record's duration and accumulator from a source word, sets it to its second state and calls a helper. It then advances the accumulator and updates the output value when the record's control flag allows.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:0374
name: finish_phase_and_configure_channel
description: Sets the phase record to its fourth state and calls a helper. It updates the accumulator when a flag bit is set, then configures the global channel record with a default duration of 1000 when no duration is given and calls a routine from a table.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:0380
name: begin_phase_segment_and_configure
description: Points the phase record at a segment entry, stores its initial accumulator and calls helpers. It updates the accumulator when a flag bit is set, then configures the global channel record with its duration and calls a routine from a table.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:03AA
name: clamp_phase_output_and_configure
description: Adds the stored output to the phase value and clamps the result to the range from zero to 32768. It subtracts the count from the accumulator, updates the flag bit, then configures the global channel record and calls a routine from a table.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:03C4
name: reset_phase_output_and_configure
description: Zeroes the phase output, subtracts the count from the accumulator and calls helpers. It updates the flag bit when required, then configures the global channel record and calls a routine from a table.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:03FC
name: configure_channel_from_phase
description: When a record flag bit is set, marks the record and calls a helper. It then configures the global channel record with a mask from a field and a default duration of 1000 when that field is zero, and calls a routine from a table.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:043E
name: store_default_duration_then_call
description: Stores a duration of 1000 and a zero word into the record, then calls a routine held in a table.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:0454
name: clear_status_bits_in_records
description: Calls a helper four times, then clears the top bit of a status byte in each of sixteen records spaced twenty bytes apart, and clears the top bit of a global status byte.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:0492
name: set_channel_bit_and_period
description: Stores a power-of-two bit mask for the channel index in the record and sets a flag byte. It calls a routine from a table and, when a field is below 37, writes 65536 to that channel's audio period register.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:04D6
name: stop_channel_and_reset_record
description: Stops a channel record: it decrements a counter in the linked record unless the state is sixteen, clears the record's state fields, sets the channel's bit mask and flag, then calls a table routine. It writes 65536 to the audio period register when the field is below 37.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:050A
name: init_channel_defaults_and_flags
description: Sets default values in a channel record: 500 in one field, 8192 in another, zero in a third, and 24 and 128 in two bytes. It then sets or clears the record's flag bits from a source bit and clears two bits while setting the top bit.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:0550
name: apply_channel_effect_command
description: Interprets a channel effect command from a two-byte record. Depending on the command code it sets or masks a channel field, scales a period from a stored value, or updates flag bits.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:0568
name: apply_channel_effect_from_code
description: Applies the subset of channel effects selected by a command code in the D0 register. It updates a mask field, a scaled period or a flag byte from the argument byte.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:0582
name: apply_period_and_flag_effect
description: Handles the period-scale, length, flag and mask effect codes using the argument byte, and clamps one field to 24 for its code.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:05C6
name: apply_flag_and_mask_effects
description: Applies the effect codes that set a channel's counter field, its flag bits, or clear its bit in the active channel table when the argument allows.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:05DC
name: apply_flag_and_table_effects
description: Handles the flag-setting codes. It sets or clears bits in the channel flags, clears the channel from the active table when the argument's bit is clear, or sets a bit in a second flag.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:0600
name: set_channel_active_flag
description: Sets the active bit in a channel's flag byte and returns.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:060A
name: apply_remaining_channel_effects
description: Handles the remaining effect codes: flag and table updates for the '@' and 'A' codes, a call to a table routine for the 'Q' code, and direct stores of the argument byte into two channel fields for the 'd' and 'e' codes.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:0622
name: clear_channel_flags_and_state
description: Clears a flag bit of the channel record, then walks a table of four records. For any entry belonging to this channel with a second bit set, it clears that bit and sets the entry's state to three.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:064E
name: apply_effect_codes_to_channel
description: Interprets a further set of channel effect codes from a command byte. It stores argument bytes into two channel fields, sets or clears a flag bit, or calls table routines for the remaining codes.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:0666
name: clear_flag_and_reset_counter
description: Clears bit two of the channel flag byte and sets a counter byte in the linked record to 255.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:0676
name: apply_subset_of_effect_codes
description: Interprets a subset of channel effect codes from a command byte. It stores argument bytes into two fields, sets or clears a flag bit, or calls table routines.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:068C
name: forward_single_helper_call
description: Calls one helper routine and returns.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:0698
name: apply_field_and_flag_effects
description: Interprets a channel effect code from a command byte. The codes for two fields store the argument into those fields, and the other codes set or clear a flag bit or call table routines.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:06A6
name: apply_partial_effect_codes
description: Handles the effect codes that store into the second channel field, set or clear the flag bit, or call a table routine, selected by the command byte.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:06B4
name: apply_flag_or_table_effect
description: Handles the effect codes that set or clear a flag bit, or call table routines, selected by the command byte.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:06C0
name: apply_flag_only_effects
description: Handles the effect codes that set or clear the flag bit, and the code that calls a table routine, selected by the command byte.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:06CC
name: set_or_clear_second_flag
description: Sets the second flag bit for one code, clears it for another, and calls a table routine for a third code, selected by the command byte.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:06DE
name: clear_second_flag_or_call
description: Clears the second flag bit of the channel for one effect code and calls a table routine for another, selected by the command byte.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:06F0
name: call_table_routine_on_match
description: Calls a routine from a table when the command byte equals one specific code, and otherwise returns.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:06FC
name: store_value_and_scaled_difference
description: Assembles a 16-bit value from two argument bytes and stores it in the record. It computes a difference from a fixed midpoint of 8192, scales it by a byte field and stores the result in a second field, then sets the top bit of a flag byte.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:0728
name: multiply_with_sign_fixup
description: Calls an unsigned helper on the magnitudes of two register values and negates the result when exactly one of the inputs is negative.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:074E
name: call_helper_return_second_result
description: Calls a helper routine and returns the value it leaves in the D1 register. The block is not reached by normal flow in the recovered program.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:0758
name: forward_single_helper_call
description: Calls one helper routine and returns.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:0760
name: divide_32bit_unsigned_value
description: Divides an unsigned 32-bit value by a 32-bit divisor, using a sixteen-step shift-and-subtract loop when the divisor's high word is nonzero and two 16-bit divides otherwise. It returns the quotient in the high longword and the remainder in the low longword.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:07D4
name: interpolate_table_shift_result
description: Interpolates between two adjacent entries of a 16-bit lookup table, using the high byte of the argument as the index and its low byte as the fraction. It then shifts the result right by a count taken from the argument's exponent, with rounding, and returns zero when that exponent is 32 or more.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:0A26
name: init_audio_state_and_interrupt
description: When not already set up, allocates a state block through exec's AllocMem routine, carves out its sub-block pointers and sets default values in them, sets a global to 64 and adds an interrupt server through exec. It returns one when the allocation fails and zero otherwise.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:0B66
name: remove_interrupt_and_free_state
description: Calls two helpers, removes the interrupt server through exec when one was added, and frees the state block through exec's FreeMem routine, clearing each pointer. It returns the FreeMem result, or zero when no block was held.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:0BCE
name: init_audio_device_and_channels
description: When not yet set up, initialises the channel records and their default fields, copies a table into place with exec's CopyMem routine and opens the audio device through exec's OpenDevice routine, using ReplyMsg during setup.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:0D48
name: close_audio_device_and_clear
description: When set up, clears flag bits in the channel records and calls a helper for each record with a flag set. It then closes the audio device through exec's CloseDevice routine and clears the device pointer.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:0DB6
name: start_channel_playback_entry
description: Starts playback on a channel record when its input byte is set and the record is active. It finds the channel's slot in a table, or obtains one through a helper, then updates the stored byte fields and timing values from the input.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:0E50
name: queue_channel_request_block
description: Takes a request block from a helper and, if one is obtained, stores the sequence pointer and length in it. It sets the block's state and default volume, defaults a duration to 1000 when none is set, and calls helpers to start the request.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:0E7C
name: queue_sequence_and_process_replies
description: Stores the sequence pointer and length in a channel record and sets its state and volume, defaulting the duration to 1000 when none is set. It then gets and replies to audio device messages through exec and starts a new request from the helper's result.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:0F50
name: service_audio_reply_queue
description: Services the audio device's reply queue: it gets and replies to messages through exec, updates the channel's counter and flag fields, and starts a new request through a helper when one is available.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:1046
name: reset_channel_record_fields
description: Clears the record's first longword, its state byte, its flag byte and two further fields.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:105A
name: match_channel_command_byte
description: Compares the input byte with a command byte stored for the channel, chosen by a flag. On a match it marks the channel as done or sets its wait flag, depending on a bit in the record.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:1094
name: match_command_byte_in_record
description: Compares the input byte with a byte in the second record. On a match it sets the record's state to three or sets a flag bit, depending on a bit in the first record.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:10AA
name: set_record_wait_flag
description: Sets bit two of the record's flag byte and returns.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:10B4
name: mark_matching_channel_entries
description: When the channel record is set, walks a table of four records and, for each one matching this record, sets its state to three or sets a flag bit, depending on a bit in the record.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:10D6
name: mark_channel_entries_from_index
description: Walks the table from a starting position for a given count, setting each entry's state to three and flagging entries that match this record.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:10E6
name: call_helper_for_matching_entries
description: When the record is set, calls a helper for each entry in a four-entry table that matches the record.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:1112
name: reset_channel_table_and_entries
description: Calls a helper for each non-empty entry in a four-entry table, then for sixteen entries spaced twenty bytes apart calls a helper, clears bit two of a flag byte and sets a counter byte to 255.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:1158
name: select_table_entry_pointer
description: Stores into the output pointer the address of a table entry chosen by the low six bits of the input byte, with each entry twenty-two bytes long.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:1174
name: store_word_and_helper_result
description: Stores the 16-bit value from the D0 register in a global variable, then calls a helper and stores its result in a second global.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:11C4
name: set_flag_from_helper_result
description: Calls a helper that touches the CIA port register, then sets bit two of a global flag byte when the returned value is zero and clears it otherwise.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:11E0
name: test_global_flag_clear
description: Returns one when bit two of a global flag byte is clear, and zero when it is set.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:11F4
name: advance_channel_timers_each_tick
description: Advances a shared tick counter and walks four channel records, updating each active record's countdown and calling helpers when a countdown expires. When a pending flag is set it first sets the top bit in each record and clears the pending flag.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:12A4
name: process_channel_events_per_tick
description: Walks an event list for each channel, subtracting a shared step from a countdown and calling a helper when the countdown expires or goes negative. It advances the list pointer and checks a flag in the channel record before finishing, reading the beam position register during the pass.
